page.layout: One column of index entries, grouped under letter headings (M, N, O, P). Running head "INDEX." at the top. Printed page number 344 at the lower left. Catchword "Pole-" at the lower right.

main_text.l: NAbis Sparta tyrannus. 369. seqq. ejus crudele facinus. 374. ejus interitus. 379
Novemviri. 17. 18. 72. 73. eorum collegium. 14 [?]. jusjurandum. 28. eorum immunitas. 76

page.notes: The grey "ΠΠ" at the lower left beside the page number looks like a stamp or mark, not printed text, so it is left out. The entry "ejusdemq;" and the Greek word beginning "Φιλίαι" are doubtful. The numeral after "eorum collegium" may be 14 or 24. The printed "Atheniens." may be "Atheniensis" (abbreviated). The top line is a fragment continuing from the previous page and stays as a fragment. Page 344 is the printed number. The entry "Achanidas" has a large initial M, which is joined to the first word.
